scope: Shared execution rules for the eight job protocols; this file authorizes no freeze or default.

route.native_effort: Per-runtime supported mapping and native orchestration retained separately
required_observations: Chat correlation join plus exclusive-window and per-attempt client-row binding for Responses; preserve upstream-attempt rows separately

destination.status: owner-observed wire max on reviewed request shapes; per-runtime actual transport, complete usage and admission remain unqualified

freeze.complete_ordered_attempt_list: Required task, repeat, arm, role and grading order with a retained hash before any quality output
freeze.block: One task-repeat across all arms, including its separate grading phase
freeze.window: Only a recorded owner allocation; unresolved isolation/coexistence terms prevent quality freeze
freeze.claude_read: Exact accepted protocol head plus scoped amendments before freeze

proposed_window.coding_admission: Unchanged first three-arm coding block bounds 195 minutes before overhead; exceeds the 180-minute reservation. Require a recorded sufficient schedule without silently reducing tasks, native verifier bounds or arms.

criteria: owner-observed gateway account rotation joined to the attempt
planned window end interrupts an incomplete block
grader transport, timeout or unparseable result
infrastructure_invalid.action: Stop dispatch, retain every original attempt and reason; rerun the entire invalid block in a later recorded window with identical frozen hashes

valid_native_failure.criteria: Runtime failure, empty/unsupported report, refusal or native agent timeout after valid infrastructure admission, classified by the frozen job oracle
valid_native_failure.action: Retain and grade under the frozen rule; no independent retry

token_or_tool_bound.criteria: Only an observed breach of a predeclared natively enforced bound
token_or_tool_bound.action: Job protocol must declare enforcement and score/validity disposition before freeze; an unenforced proposed cap is not a measured bound

recovery.native_internal_retries: Declare every runtime/helper/SDK retry separately; unsupported zero claims prevent freeze
recovery.on_third_invalid_block: Abort the study and report all retained failures; no winner
recovery.invalid_task: Retain task for all arms and recover the entire block, or abort; no selective dropping
recovery.recovery_receipt: Names old/new allocation, original invalid attempts, unchanged hashes and recovery ordinal; not a silent retry

usage.authoritative_aggregate: Exactly one native or owner-returned complete aggregate per arm/attempt, named before freeze
usage.efficiency_metric: uncached input tokens plus output tokens
usage.gross_input_output: Retained separately; cached input and reasoning output subsets are not added twice
usage.missingness: Unknown stays null; normalized zeros, estimates and price-table costs are not observed consumption or billing

every_arm: unique correlation id for Chat; exclusive Responses window plus retained attempt start/end and client-row mapping
request_controls.cache_limits: No-cache does not disable upstream prompt caching
request_controls.metadata: Allowlisted values only; no accounts, tokens, request bodies or auth/configuration exports
request_controls.row_counting: Count client rows with requestedModel; do not sum their upstream-attempt duplicates. Retain complete original row field presence, status and helper coverage before declaring usage complete.

amendments: Every changed task/model/route/evaluator/limit/rule is a prospective recorded amendment read by both families; historical gates and earlier failures retain their original conditions.
